title: M3 — Browser text encoding and hybrid search
description: Pinned q8 CLAP text-only WASM encoder in lazy Web Worker. Immediate unchanged lexical results plus automatic sound groups after600ms or Enter. Cache, progress, retry, cancellation and stale response guards. Global/Samples/Clips integration with existing filters; saved clips only in Clips. Depends M0 and M1. WebGPU excluded.

comments.text: Board sync 2026-10-20: status unchanged (in_progress, not closable). Closed children: 89a75e (lazy encoder worker), 9c0405 (query normalisation), c709ec (hybrid results). Still open: e711eb (verify first-use downloads and failure recovery) and story 2dc2d0. e711eb has not started; it depends on the M0 browser parity and mobile evidence on apricitus-e46692. right_now_summary: Browser search and playback work, but cold-download, mobile performance, and failure recovery still need proof.
